## Findings
- claim-1: \(\Lambda/I_{r,q}\) has integral Schur basis \(\{\bar s_\lambda:\lambda\subseteq q^r\}\), with \(q=n-r\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 213-218]
- claim-2: The antipode satisfies \(S(s_\lambda)=(-1)^{|\lambda|}s_{\lambda'}\); the resulting integral Hopf identity is proved there. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 702-735]
- claim-3: Let \(A=\Lambda/I_{r,q}\), \(Q=J_v/A_+J_v\), and assume \(a+j\le r,\ a+i\le q,\ b\le i,j\). For every \(\rho\subseteq b^a\), \[ [\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}] =(-1)^{|\rho|} [\bar s_{(i+\rho'_1,\ldots,i+\rho'_b,i^{j-b})}] \quad\text{in }Q. \tag{E} \]
- claim-4: For \((i,j,a,b)=(2,3,2,2)\), (E) gives \[ [222]=[222],\quad [2221]=-[322],\quad [2222]=[332], \] \[ [22211]=[422],\quad [22221]=-[432],\quad [22222]=[442], \] against complete integral relation lattices. [artifact b525c6b69aec42dfda85ba9b819a6a11265e17552b8c81c742e5f276ef669fc4]
## Strategy
Let \(A=\Lambda/I_{r,q}\), \(q=n-r\), and \(Q=J_v/A_+J_v\). For \(\rho\subseteq b^a\), pad \(\rho\) to \(a\) parts and \(\rho'\) to \(b\) parts. The intended statement is
\[
[\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}]
=(-1)^{|\rho|}
[\bar s_{(i+\rho'_1,\ldots,i+\rho'_b,i^{j-b)} }]\quad\text{in }Q. \tag{E}
\]
Here \(i^0\) is omitted when \(b=j\). The inequalities \(b\le i,j\), \(a+i\le q\), and \(a+j\le r\) ensure both partitions lie in \(q^r\).

A sufficient integral identity is
\[
s_{(i^j,\rho)}-(-1)^{|\rho|}s_{R_\rho}
=\sum_{\sigma\subsetneq\rho}F_{\rho,\sigma}s_{(i^j,\sigma)},
\qquad
F_{\rho,\sigma}\in\Lambda_{|\rho|-|\sigma|}, \tag{C}
\]
where \(R_\rho=(i+\rho'_1,\ldots,i+\rho'_b,i^{j-b})\). Projecting (C) to \(A\) would put its right side in \(A_+J_v\), proving (E).

## Gaps
The required derivation of (C) is absent. The accepted full-coordinate Hopf descent is an identity among \(\operatorname{Lin}_\varphi\)-rows; no defined rectangle-attachment map carries it to (C), identifies the endpoint coefficients, or proves that all remaining attachments have \(\sigma\subsetneq\rho\). The graded-kernel presentation gives independence of the lower classes but supplies no coordinates for \([\bar s_{R_\rho}]\).

Boundary cases are harmless but do not repair the general gap: if \(\rho=\varnothing\), including \(a=0\), (E) is the tautology \([\bar s_{i^j}]=[\bar s_{i^j}]\). When \(b=j\), the final \(i^0\) is omitted.

Artifact `b525c6b69aec42dfda85ba9b819a6a11265e17552b8c81c742e5f276ef669fc4` verifies only
\[
[222]=[222],\ [2221]=-[322],\ [2222]=[332],\
[22211]=[422],\ [22221]=-[432],\ [22222]=[442]
\]
for \((i,j,a,b)=(2,3,2,2)\). This finite evidence does not establish (E) generally.

Thus this certificate is not established.

## Next
Provide a termwise-defined rectangle-attachment map applied to the integral Hopf identity, proving (C) with explicit \(F_{\rho,\sigma}\), endpoint coefficients \(1\) and \(-(-1)^{|\rho|}\), and strict containment \(\sigma\subsetneq\rho\).
